name: SonarQube
description: Let agents read code quality results in SonarQube: whether a project, branch or pull request passes its quality gate, the issues that fail it and the main measures such as coverage. For review prep and failed pipeline triage.
identity: A SonarQube user token of an account made for agents. It sees what that account may browse.

setup.title: Create an account for agents
setup.body: In SonarQube Server, an administrator creates a local user for agents and gives it Browse on the projects agents should read, through a permission template or each project's permissions. In SonarQube Cloud, add a member to your organization the same way. A user token carries every permission of its user, so give this user nothing more.
click: Administration > Security > Users > Create User. Name: AI agents.
Each project agents should read: Project Settings > Permissions > give AI agents Browse.

setup.title: Create a user token
setup.body: Sign in as the agents' user and create a token of type User. SonarQube shows it only once. You can test it with the command below: it answers whether the token is valid and changes nothing.
click: Name: AI agents. Type: User. Choose an expiration date, then select Generate and copy the token.

fields.label: SonarQube address
fields.help: The host name of your SonarQube Server, such as sonarqube.example.com, or sonarcloud.io for SonarQube Cloud.

capabilities.label: Read quality results
capabilities.description: Read a project's, branch's or pull request's quality gate status, search its issues, read measures such as coverage and duplication, and list a project's pull requests.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Reaches every project the agents' user may browse unless you keep a key to chosen projects.

limits.label: Projects
limits.help: Optional: only these projects, by project key (shown on the project's Information page). Leave empty for every project the user may browse.

revoke: Sign in as the agents' user, go to Account menu > My account > Security and revoke the token, or have an administrator deactivate the user. Agents lose access to SonarQube at once.

tools.name: sonarqube_get_quality_gate_status
tools.description: Read whether a project passes its quality gate, on its main branch or on one branch or pull request, with each condition's actual value and threshold.

branch.description: A branch name, instead of the main branch

pull_request.description: A pull request or merge request id, instead of a branch
pull_request.name: pullRequest

tools.name: sonarqube_search_issues
tools.description: Search a project's issues, on its main branch or on one branch or pull request: rule, severity, file, line and message. Pass page to read further pages.

branch.description: A branch name, instead of the main branch

pull_request.description: A pull request or merge request id, instead of a branch
pull_request.name: pullRequest

resolved.description: true for resolved issues only, false for open ones only

tools.name: sonarqube_get_measures
tools.description: Read measures of a project, branch or pull request, such as coverage, new_coverage, bugs, vulnerabilities, code_smells, duplicated_lines_density or ncloc.

metric_keys.description: Metric keys, such as coverage or bugs
metric_keys.name: metricKeys

branch.description: A branch name, instead of the main branch

pull_request.description: A pull request or merge request id, instead of a branch
pull_request.name: pullRequest

tools.name: sonarqube_list_pull_requests
tools.description: List a project's analyzed pull requests with each one's branches, quality gate status and date of analysis.
